explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/1182: 'The upper bound was improved to F(n) ≤ 84n by Brandt [Br96]'. The Lean statement: F n ≤ 84·n for all sufficiently large n. Restricting to large n is a mild weakening of the page's unqualified bound and is documented (the preprint was not consulted by the formaliser either); it still yields the negative answer to F(n)/n → ∞. Faithful to the page.
